 How to watch Jordan v Australia: Live stream, TV channel, kick-off time and head-to-head stats
 Matt Gibbs
 Published: 10 hours ago
 Australia will be looking to end their year on a high when they take on Jordan in an international friendly on Tuesday. 
 The Socceroos picked up a 3-0 victory against Qatar on Friday and they will be targeting another win to close out 2026.
They face Jordan for the first time since June 2022, when Australia secured a 2-1 win in a friendly.

 How to watch Jordan v Australia, live stream and TV channel
 Jordan v Australia is available to watch live in Australia via Paramount+.
 Jordan v Australia kick-off time, date and venue
 Jordan v Australia will be played at the Suhaim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha, Qatar and kick-off is at 16:00 GMT on Tuesday 17th November.
